_comment: Map markers whose wiki article is spelled differently from ours.
The join is marker.article -> location.wiki_page, and 27 of 46 match on
their own. These three do not, and each is a real difference rather than a
typo, so they are written down with the reason instead of being absorbed by
ANCHORS ONLY. An entry here says 'this marker is that location's position'.
It does not create a location, and a marker with no entry and no matching
page is left alone rather than attached to whatever is nearest — geometric
containment would be an inference, and this file is for facts.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. The five mine biomes have no anchor and never
will: a biome is a range of floors, not a place on the overworld, so its
position is *not applicable* rather than unknown. The Bell Tower and Balor's
Wagon have no marker at all — the wagon is a travelling merchant and may
genuinely have no fixed spot. Those three stay as honest gaps.

anchors.reason: The marker links to the article 'Farm'; our page is 'The_Farm'. Same place, two spellings.
The marker links to 'Mines'; our page is 'The_Mines'.

The gardens have no marker of their own. The gazebo stands in them and is the only published point inside them, so it serves as the anchor — the pin is a few metres off centre, which is well inside the accuracy this map claims anyway.
